errors.text_span: 用于展示“搭配组数标准差”随时间（年份）变化的情况
errors.evidence: The chart purpose is described as showing '搭配组数标准差,' but the figure and atom checklist do not specify this metric.
The peak value of the solid line is described as approximately 66, but the figure shows a value far above 60 but below 70, closer to 68.
The dotted line starts at 0 in 1946, not approximately 8 as stated.
The peak value of the dotted line is described as approximately 29–30, but the figure shows a peak closer to 30 in the mid-1950s.
The description does not mention that the solid line has multiple peaks between 1960 and 1980.
The description does not mention that the solid line ends slightly above 0 in 2018.
The description does not mention that the dotted line ends close to 0 in 2018.
The description does not clearly state that the chart shows changes in an unspecified metric over time from 1946 to 2018.

errors.evidence: The description provides excessive detail about individual years and values, which reduces readability without adding significant informational value.
